short: The façade re-exports and the unit of work
is: Three façade files — elements and ports re-exported from kernel, identity and workflow, plus datetime and string_builder from kernel — and the unit of work, which stays here because it vends the write ports of both identity and workflow.
conventions: The façade files are declarations only: a new port or element lands in its domain crate and reaches `domain::` through the glob re-exports, with no façade edit.
Time is injected, never read from the ambient clock.

fs.name: elements.rs
fs.role: re-exports the elements of kernel, identity and workflow

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: crate root: the façade's modules and the kernel re-exports (datetime, string_builder)

fs.name: ports.rs
fs.role: re-exports the identity and workflow ports flat, and the unit of work

refs.title: The Changelog as the Only Record

notes: `UnitOfWork` vends exactly nine write ports: `accounts`, `commissions`, `changelog`, `users`, `actor_identities`, `workflows`, `columns`, `characters`, `bug_reports`. `ports::Unit<'a>` names `&'a mut dyn UnitOfWork`, the type a `#[unit]` parameter takes.

Documented exceptions to the Unit of Work — pool-backed `&self` writes: `ProfileCache` (read-through cache fill), `FileStore` (blob bytes can't ride a Postgres transaction), and the api-side `session_store`/`auth_store`.
